rootCause.detail: The UI and category definition described the yellow-card challenge as a historical/global club ranking. The API response and source fact are only an active 2026 snapshot for the three included competitions. The served snapshot was generated on 2026-09-21; the already verified checkpoint has newer facts captured through 2026-09-28. No identity collision, league attribution error or duplicate fact was found for Marcos. The public API response itself also carries a legacy global-career category label despite dataset=active_weekly; the UI now normalizes that label and displays the explicit active-season scope. The API response was left unchanged to avoid a Render deployment.
